statement: Find the area of the triangle with vertices $(1,0,0)$, $(0,1,0)$ and $(0,0,1)$.
solution: $\overrightarrow{AB}=(-1,1,0)$, $\overrightarrow{AC}=(-1,0,1)$; their cross product is $(1,1,1)$ with magnitude $\sqrt3$. The area is $\tfrac12\sqrt3$.
hints: Form two edge vectors from one vertex.
Take half the magnitude of their cross product.
